entity.description: Per-module preview row for the referenced entity.

content.description: Document body. For type=doc, accepts Markdown (recommended) or a ProseMirror JSON string. HTML is tolerated best-effort: a tag the editor schema maps becomes its node or mark, so `x` stores `x` in bold. A tag it does not map is kept as literal text, attributes and closing tag verbatim, so `` survives a round trip. Styling and decorative wrappers are still dropped and are listed in `import_warnings` on the response. For type=sheet/slide, see the respective module's authoring format.

owner_username.description: Owner's username (slug-form). Populated for both human and agent owners; null only when owner row has no username.

content.description: Authoring format. Docs use ProseMirror JSON; sheets/slides use JSON canvas. May be null on freshly-created entities.

workspace_email.description: Computed in-workspace address (`<username>@<default-workspace-domain>`). A verified custom domain is used only after an Admin selects it as the workspace default.

avatar_url.description: Profile avatar URL. Present on comment author refs; absent on document envelopes.

type.description: Owner principal type. Always present on document envelopes; absent on comment author refs.

support.description: Server-derived: true when the author is an active Ambiguous Support session (a time-boxed membership). Never client-writable.

import_warnings.description: Content the conversion could not represent, one string per drop. A tag with no schema mapping is kept as literal text and is not a drop; this reports styling, decorative wrappers and head-only elements. Present on every `type: doc` create and update, empty when nothing was dropped. Absent for sheets and slides, and for an editor-session save, which stores no converted body.

content.description: Replacement document body. For type=doc, accepts Markdown (recommended) or a ProseMirror JSON string. HTML is tolerated best-effort: a mapped tag becomes its node or mark, an unmapped tag is kept as literal text, and styling and decorative wrappers are dropped and listed in `import_warnings` on the response. Mutually exclusive with `operations`.

suggesting.description: Commenter-relaxed write: content changes must carry track-change marks (auto-wrapped for agents).

operations.description: Block-id-targeted edits as an alternative to `content` replacement. `content` field on each op is Markdown that is converted to PM JSON and applied at the matched blockId.

status_counts.description: Count per system status across the whole filter, not just this page.

custom_status_counts.description: Count per custom status id across the whole filter, not just this page.

blocked_task_ids.description: IDs of tasks in `data` whose dependencies are not all done.

archived_count.description: Count of archived tasks matching the filter (regardless of `showArchived`).

limit.description: Echo of the request `limit` (offset mode only).

offset.description: Echo of the request `offset` (offset mode only).

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. With `due_date`, defines a date range for the task.

contact_id.description: CRM contact this task is associated with. Auto-logs CRM activities.

deal_id.description: CRM deal this task is associated with.

task_key.description: Workspace-scoped human-readable key like `WS-123`. Stable across renames.

task_status_id.description: Custom status ID (overrides system `status` category). When set, the system `status` field is synced from the custom status's category.

recurrence_rule.description: RRULE string per RFC 5545 (e.g. `FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO`). When set, completing the task spawns the next occurrence.

estimate.description: Story-point estimate (typically 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13). Used in velocity reports.

estimated_minutes.description: Time-budget estimate in minutes. Used in workload + analytics reports.

time_spent_minutes.description: Sum of time-tracking entries for this task. Auto-updated when time entries are logged or removed.

custom_field_values.description: Per-task values keyed by `task_custom_fields.id`. Shape varies by field type (string, number, ISO date, array of option ids, etc.).

goal_id.description: OKR-style goal this task contributes to. Drives goal progress aggregates.

cycle_id.description: Sprint/cycle this task is scheduled in.

first_response_at.description: Timestamp of the first response (status change off `todo`). Drives the response SLA timer.

completed_at.description: Set when status flips to `done` or `cancelled`. Cleared on un-complete.

archived_at.description: Soft-archive timestamp. Archived tasks are hidden from default list filters.

trashed_at.description: Soft-delete timestamp. Trashed tasks are restorable for 30 days.

labels.description: Labels applied to this task, in display order.

subtask_count.description: Count of direct child tasks (subtasks). Hydrated on list responses.

comment_count.description: Count of top-level comment threads on this task. Hydrated on list responses.

subscriber_count.description: Count of users subscribed to this task. Hydrated on list responses.

subscriber_ids.description: User IDs of subscribers. Echoed on create/update/list so callers avoid a second GET to the subscriptions sub-resource.

pr_count.description: Count of GitHub PRs linked to this task via the changelog / dev-tools integration.

latest_pr_status.description: Status of the most-recent linked PR (open / merged / closed).

subscribers.description: Users subscribed to this task (notified on changes). Returned on single-task GET to avoid forcing a second round-trip to the subscriptions sub-resource.

Task.description: Full task entity as returned by `GET /api/tasks/:id`.

TaskStatus.description: System task status category. Drives the built-in board columns.

TaskPriority.description: Task priority. Determines SLA timer and sort weight.

TaskDueDateSource.description: Who set the task's due date. `manual` = user-entered; `sla` = auto-set by the priority SLA policy. Persists across updates so SLA bumps don't overwrite explicit edits.

TaskSlaSummary.description: SLA tracker. `null` legs mean the SLA timer hasn't been initialized for this task.

TaskSlaCheckpoint.description: One leg of the SLA tracker: either response (time to first reply / status change) or resolution (time to done).

project_id.description: `null` for workspace-level labels; project UUID for project-scoped labels.

TaskLabelEmbed.description: Label as it appears embedded on a task response.

TaskUserSummary.description: Compact user reference embedded on task creator/assignee. Avoids forcing the client to do a second lookup for the common name+email+avatar render. `primary_email` may be null for accounts without a verified email; `avatar_url` is null when the user has no avatar (clients render initials).

title.description: Task title. Required. Max 255 chars; trimmed before insert.

description.description: Markdown body. Rendered with the standard task-card markdown subset.

status.description: Initial status. Defaults to `todo`. If `task_status_id` is also set, that takes precedence and `status` is overridden by the custom status's category.

assignee_id.description: User to assign the task to. Must be in the caller's workspace (403 otherwise). Omit for unassigned.

due_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). If unset and a `priority` is given, the SLA policy auto-sets a due date and stamps `due_date_source: 'sla'`.

start_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD); with `due_date` defines a date range.

parent_task_id.description: Parent task for subtasks. Omit for top-level tasks.

contact_id.description: Link the task to a CRM contact; auto-logs a CRM activity row.

deal_id.description: Link the task to a CRM deal.

recurrence_rule.description: RFC 5545 RRULE string. When set, completing the task spawns the next occurrence.

goal_id.description: Link the task to an OKR-style goal.

cycle_id.description: Sprint/cycle this task is scheduled in.

label_ids.description: Labels to assign at create time. Each ID must reference a label in the caller's workspace (404 otherwise).

subscriber_ids.description: Users to subscribe to the task at create time so they receive update notifications. Each must be a member of the caller's workspace; IDs outside the workspace are silently skipped. Use to link a bug reporter to the filed task.

TaskCreateInput.description: Body of `POST /api/tasks`. Captures the union of fields any surface accepts.

TaskCreateResponse.description: Response body for `POST /api/tasks`. Wrapped in `{ task }` for legacy compatibility.

due_date_source.description: Defaults to `manual` when `due_date` changes through this update. Set explicitly to `sla` to mark a system-set due date.

time_spent_minutes.description: Manual override; usually auto-managed by time entries.

subscriber_ids.description: Users to subscribe to this task so they receive update notifications. Additive â existing subscribers are untouched. Each must be a workspace member; IDs outside the workspace are silently skipped. Use to backfill a bug reporter onto an existing task.

TaskUpdateInput.description: Body of `PATCH /api/tasks/:id`. All fields optional; `null` clears nullable fields.

lead_score.description: Sum of matched scoring-rule points. Defaults to 0.

ContactType.description: `person` is a human contact; `company` is the organisation entity.

LifecycleStage.description: HubSpot-style funnel stage. Drives default board columns and per-stage automation.

ContactCreateInput.description: Create a CRM contact. `name` is the canonical field; `first_name`/`last_name` are accepted as a HubSpot-style alias and concatenated to `name` server-side. `type` defaults to `person` when `first_name`/`last_name` are provided. Sending both `name` and `first_name`/`last_name` with conflicting values 400s. Unknown keys are rejected with 400 so a mistyped field (e.g. camelCase `customProperties`) fails loudly instead of silently dropping data.
